newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Bank of Ireland H1 pretax profit rises.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Ireland H1 pretax profit rises.

text.p: NOTE - Analysts' forecasts on pre-tax profits were in a range of 190 to 194 million punts.
Div registration date December 3 NOTE - Bank of Ireland Plc is one of Ireland's largest banking and financial services groups.
The impact of its New Hampshire business and Citizens Financial Group in the U.S. is excluded from the above figures to provide a more meaningful comparison of group performance, the bank said.
Bank of Ireland said that its capital position was very strong. The Tier 1 and Total Capital ratios as at September 30, 1996 were 10.7 percent and 14.7 percent respectively.
Bank of Ireland said its grossed up net interest margin was 3.8 percent compared with 3.9 percent a year earlier.
Its cost/income ratio edged up to 58 percent from 57 percent while the return on average stockholders was 21.7 percent against 26.4 percent in the first half of 1995.
